title: Lipschitz bound for the Gaussian distribution function
statement: For all $x,y\in\mathbb R$, the standard Gaussian distribution function $\Phi$ satisfies $|\Phi(x)-\Phi(y)|\le\varphi(0)|x-y|$, where $\varphi$ is the standard Gaussian density.
replaced: The standard Gaussian distribution function and density satisfy $|\Phi(x)-\Phi(y)|\le\varphi(0)|x-y|$ for all $x,y\in\mathbb R$.
